resources.string:
Peak Rush reads your daily step count to give you a small Trail Points bonus (1 TP per 500 steps, up to 40 TP a day).

Only step counts are read, only while the game is open, and only steps taken after you switched the step counter on. Your step data stays on this phone: it is never uploaded or shared.

You can switch it off in Peak Rush, Settings, or remove the permission in Health Connect.
